{"failure_class": "closing step skipped",
 "root_cause": "The agent made the main update and finished. The request ended with a closing step, logging a follow-up task for the contact, and the agent's last message says nothing in its instructions covers closing steps of this kind. The only failed check is the follow-up task.",
 "mechanism": "A working note that tells the agent: when a request ends by asking to log a follow-up task for the contact, create that task with the title the request gives before finishing.",
 "component": "memory",
 "generality": "Every request that ends with a follow-up task hits the same gap: the agent stops after the main update when its instructions do not name the closing step."}
